prt_porto_s_o_bento_azulejo_panels.webp.note: Image 2 shows the cornice molding above and the yellow tile dado below the panel, so wall and architecture outside the artwork are visible.

ita_the_last_supper.webp.note: Image 2 extends beyond the painting, showing the upper lunettes with coats of arms and an invented tiled floor outside the original artwork.

gbr_sunflowers.webp.note: Background is yellow instead of pale blue-green, there are more flowers in a different arrangement, and the vase lacks the 'Vincent' signature, so it reads as a different painting.

gbr_the_hay_wain.webp.note: Recognisable reworking of The Hay Wain; composition altered (square crop, added horses, woman, fence) but same subject and palette.

gbr_happy_accident_on_the_swing.webp.note: Palette shifted from dark teal-green and blue-grey to warm golden-brown and olive; composition is rearranged, though still recognisable.

nld_almond_blossom.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: branches and blossoms are rearranged and more regular, so it is not a recognisable copy of Van Gogh's original.

can_massacre_of_the_innocents.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: a long street with a frozen stream and many helmeted soldiers. It is not Bruegel's layout, though the style is similar.

fra_self_portrait.webp.note: Image 2 shows an elderly man with clasped hands, not the young open-mouthed man in a beret and gorget.

fra_the_bridge_at_narni.webp.note: Composition differs: added hilltop town, donkey rider, agave; bridge arches and river layout don't match Corot's Narni, which has a broken arch on the right and a distant bridge.

usa_dogs_playing_poker.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: dogs at a round table under a lamp, not the train-car scene with a conductor dog.

fra_arrangement_in_grey_and_black_no_1.w.note: Recognisable reproduction of Whistler's Mother; curtain moved to the right and recoloured, but the composition and palette are broadly consistent.

usa_saint_george_and_the_dragon.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the layout is mirrored, the knight has a plumed helmet, a castle and flower meadow were added, and the cave and dragon are changed.

usa_breezing_up.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: three figures in a white dinghy with an island, not the original's four boys, boat named Gloucester, and layout.

gbr_the_ladies_waldegrave.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the hairstyles are not powdered grey, the poses differ, and the window, landscape and red chairs are missing. It is not recognisable as The Ladies Waldegrave.

fra_et_in_arcadia_ego.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-imagined composition: the figures are posed differently, the skull sits on a stone block, and the Guercino inscription, owl and tree are missing.

usa_the_avenue_in_the_rain.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: a hazy mauve street with a carriage and distant flags, not Hassam's blue close-up flags with umbrellas. Palette is muted purple-gray.

fra_patrocles.webp.note: Image 2 shows a mourning crowd of soldiers around a corpse and pyre, not the lone seated nude seen from behind in the original.

fra_napoleon_crossing_the_alps.webp.note: Horse changed from white/grey to brown and cape from red to golden-yellow; overall palette differs noticeably, though composition is recognisable.

nld_wheatfield_with_crows.webp.note: Sky is noticeably darker than the original, but the overall palette and composition match.

fra_a_cotton_office_in_new_orleans.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the layout, figures, desks with ledgers, and room differ from Degas's painting, so it is not recognisable as the original.

usa_the_gross_clinic.webp.note: Image 2 is a recomposed imitation: figures, poses and layout differ (patient position, no red wall, different surgeons), so it is not recognisably the same painting.

fra_water_lilies.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: sky reflections, many small lilies and ripples, unlike the original's close-up of large pads and two pink blooms.

usa_the_peaceable_kingdom.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: animals regrouped, no Penn treaty scene, no ship, no text borders; it is a generic peaceable kingdom.

usa_pollice_verso.webp.note: Reproduction recomposes the scene: a single standing gladiator over a fallen foe, a different arena and box, and no Pollice Verso composition.

fra_the_embarkation_to_cythera.webp.note: Image 2 is a recomposed variation: a boat with canopy, a different layout, and a statue on the left. It is not recognisable as Watteau's original composition.

gbr_the_laughing_cavalier.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: different pose, smaller lace collar, simpler black embroidered doublet, no inscription, hat tilted differently. It is not recognisable as The Laughing Cavalier.

deu_the_fox.webp.note: Image 2 shows a single curled-up sleeping fox on a blue, green and purple geometric field, not Marc's two upright red foxes; the palette is far cooler.

usa_the_grand_canal_venice.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: Gothic palazzi and Santa Maria della Salute dome replace Turner's layout, with no matching church portico, campanile or banners.

gbr_a_boat_passing_a_lock.webp.note: Different composition: no stormy sky, lockkeeper, or dog; adds cottage, horse and bright blue sky, so the colour scheme is much lighter.

mlt_the_beheading_of_saint_john_the_bapt.note: Same subject but recomposed: figures rearranged, bound hands, seated man added, arch removed, bowl placement changed; not recognisable as Caravaggio's composition.

ita_deposition_from_the_cross.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: figures, poses and setting (rocky hill) differ from Rosso Fiorentino's work. Image 1 also shows an arched border and wall.

fra_dance_at_le_moulin_de_la_galette.web.note: Image 2 is a reimagined scene: different composition, figures and poses; the central seated group and dancing couple are not recognisably the original.

fra_grande_odalisque.webp.note: Pose, composition and props differ: she lies prone on pillows holding a peacock fan, with a hookah upright. It is a reinterpretation, not the original.

fra_the_thinker.webp.note: Garden background with topiary, gravel path, distant wall and stone pedestal visible; not a plain background.

vat_piet.webp.note: Image 2 shows a pedestal base and a dark blue wall with columns, not a plain background. The marble is similar in colour to the original.

ita_ecstasy_of_saint_teresa.webp.note: Image 2 shows the surrounding chapel architecture: columns, capitals, cornice and wall marble panels, all outside the artwork. The marble is also redder/browner.

usa_composition_viii.webp.note: Image 2 is a loose reinterpretation of Kandinsky's Composition VIII. Shapes, layout and elements are rearranged, so it isn't recognisable as the original.
